onChange.script:
try:
		if origin != 'Browser':
			return
		if self.session.custom.ReadOnly or not self.view.params.permissions:
			shared.Alerts.revertPending(self, 'props.selected')
			return
		tagPath = self.view.params.tagPath
		if not tagPath:
			shared.Alerts.revertPending(self, 'props.selected')
			return
		newValue = bool(currentValue.value)
		oldValue = bool(previousValue.value) if previousValue is not None else (not newValue)
		if newValue == oldValue:
			return
		self.view.custom.timeOut.startTime = system.date.now()
		self.view.custom.timeOut.actionComplete = False
		label = self.view.params.label or str(tagPath).split('/')[-2]
		shared.Alerts.promptPendingWrite(self, 'props.selected',
			label=label,
			tagPath=tagPath,
			newValue=newValue,
			oldValue=oldValue,
			title='Apply configuration',
			extraPayload={'viewName': self.view.id.split('@')[0]},
		)
	except:
		system.util.getLogger('ConfirmBoolean').info('Error prompting apply write')
		try:
			shared.Alerts.revertPending(self, 'props.selected')
		except:
			pass
